@media(forced-colors:active){#${HOST_ID} .sp-card{border-color:CanvasText}#${HOST_ID} button{border-color:ButtonText}}
`;

  function createView(deps){
    const d=deps||{};
    const doc=d.document,win=d.window||root;
    const fetchImpl=d.fetch;
    const later=d.setTimeout||((fn,ms)=>setTimeout(fn,ms)),cancel=d.clearTimeout||(id=>clearTimeout(id));
    const every=d.setInterval||((fn,ms)=>setInterval(fn,ms)),stopEvery=d.clearInterval||(id=>clearInterval(id));
    const now=d.now||(()=>Date.now());
    const sink=d.console||null;
    const S={open:false,preview:null,previewError:null,loading:false,consent:false,description:'',busy:null,bundle:null,
      said:null,status:null,editing:false,tick:0,returnFocus:null,pending:null,saveOffered:false,sent:false,waiting:false};
    let host=null,ui=null;

    function log(level,key,data){
      const line=`[support] support.${key} ${JSON.stringify(data||{})}`;
      try{if(sink){if(level==='error')sink.error(line);else if(level==='warn')sink.warn(line);else sink.info(line)}}
      catch(_e){/* intentional: a broken console must not break the page */}
      try{const obs=d.obsClientLog||win.obsClientLog;if(level!=='info'&&typeof obs==='function')obs(level,level==='error'?'ERROR':'WARN',`support_${key}`,data||{})}
      catch(_e){/* intentional: the journal is optional on this page */}
    }

    /* Requête bornée : la réponse ET son corps tiennent dans l'échéance ; un refus rend `{code, message, detail}`. */
    async function call(method,path,deadline,body){
      let timer=0;
      const controller=typeof win.AbortController==='function'?new win.AbortController():null;
      const expiry=new Promise((_,reject)=>{timer=later(()=>{if(controller)controller.abort();
        reject(Object.assign(new Error(`pas de réponse après ${Math.round(deadline/1000)} s`),{code:'timeout'}))},deadline)});
      const read=(async()=>{
        if(!fetchImpl)throw Object.assign(new Error('la porte réseau de la page manque'),{code:'network'});
        const init={method,cache:'no-store',signal:controller?controller.signal:undefined};
        if(method==='POST'){init.headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'};init.body=JSON.stringify(body||{})}
        const response=await fetchImpl(path,init);
        let payload=null;try{payload=await response.json()}catch(_e){payload=null /* intentional: reported below */}
        if(!response.ok){
          const e=isObject(payload)&&isObject(payload.error)?payload.error:{};
          throw Object.assign(new Error(text(e.message)||`HTTP ${response.status}`),{code:text(e.code)||`http_${response.status}`,detail:text(e.detail)});
        }
        if(!isObject(payload))throw Object.assign(new Error('réponse illisible'),{code:'support_payload_invalid'});
        return payload;
      })();
      expiry.catch(()=>{/* intentional: the race reports it */});read.catch(()=>{/* intentional: the race reports it */});
      try{return await Promise.race([read,expiry])}finally{if(timer)cancel(timer)}
    }

    async function loadPreview(){
      S.loading=true;render();
      try{
        const parsed=parsePreview(await call('GET',PREVIEW_ROUTE,PREVIEW_DEADLINE_MS));
        if(!parsed.ok)throw Object.assign(new Error('aperçu illisible'),{code:parsed.code});
        S.preview=parsed.preview;S.previewError=null;
        /* Seconde reprise m-d : un envoi encore en attente (même ouvert d'une autre fois) bloque « Envoyer ». */
        if(S.preview.sendInProgress)S.waiting=true;
        log('info','preview',{board:!!S.preview.board,approx_bytes:S.preview.approxBytes,transport:S.preview.transport.name});
      }catch(error){
        S.previewError={code:text(error&&error.code)||'network',message:text(error&&error.message)};
        log('warn','preview_failed',S.previewError);
      }finally{S.loading=false;render()}
    }

    function fail(error,prefix){
      const code=text(error&&error.code)||'network';
      S.said={kind:'failed',text:`${prefix} ${text(error&&error.message)||'L’action n’a pas abouti.'}`,detail:[code,text(error&&error.detail)].filter(Boolean).join(' : ')};
      return code;
    }

    async function ensureBundle(){
      if(S.bundle)return S.bundle;
      const limit=createDeadline(S.preview);
      S.busy={kind:'create',since:now(),label:'Préparation du paquet et du rapport',limit};render();
      const answer=await call('POST',CREATE_ROUTE,limit,{consent:true,description:S.description.slice(0,DESCRIPTION_MAX)});
      const b=isObject(answer.bundle)?answer.bundle:null;
      if(!b||typeof b.name!=='string')throw Object.assign(new Error('réponse sans paquet'),{code:'support_payload_invalid'});
      S.bundle={name:b.name,bytes:Number(b.bytes)||0,reportKind:text(b.report_kind),aiStatus:text(b.ai_status),aiDetail:text(b.ai_detail),
        sendable:b.sendable!==false,omitted:Array.isArray(b.omitted)?b.omitted.length:0};
      log('info','created',{name:S.bundle.name,bytes:S.bundle.bytes,report_kind:S.bundle.reportKind});
      return S.bundle;
    }

    async function act(kind){
      if(kind==='send'&&S.sent){close('done');return}
      const reason=blockedReason(S,kind);
      if(reason){S.status={kind:'failed',text:reason};render();log('info','blocked',{act:kind,reason});return}
      S.said=null;S.status=null;S.pending=kind; /* l'acte qui demande la création : son bouton est marqué occupé */
      try{
        await ensureBundle();
        if(kind==='send'){
          S.busy={kind:'send',since:now(),label:'Remise à votre messagerie',limit:SEND_DEADLINE_MS};render();
          const outcome=await call('POST',`${CREATE_ROUTE}/${encodeURIComponent(S.bundle.name)}/send`,SEND_DEADLINE_MS,{});
          S.said={kind:outcome.status==='waiting'?'info':'ok',text:text(outcome.message)};
          /* Remis : le bouton principal devient « Fermer » (jamais un second envoi du même paquet par réflexe). */
          S.sent=outcome.status!=='waiting';S.waiting=outcome.status==='waiting';
          log('info','sent',{name:S.bundle.name,status:text(outcome.status)});
        }else{
          S.said={kind:'ok',text:'Paquet prêt. Choisissez où l’enregistrer.'};S.saveOffered=true;
        }
      }catch(error){
        const code=fail(error,kind==='send'&&S.bundle?'Envoi impossible :':'Paquet non créé :');
        if(kind==='send'&&S.bundle)S.saveOffered=true;
        log('error',kind==='send'&&S.bundle?'send_failed':'create_failed',{code,message:text(error&&error.message),detail:text(error&&error.detail)});
      }finally{S.busy=null;S.pending=null;render()}
    }

    async function saveToDocuments(button){
      if(!S.bundle||S.busy)return;
      S.busy={kind:'save',since:now(),label:'Copie dans Documents\\Jarvis',limit:SAVE_DEADLINE_MS};render();
      try{
        const outcome=await call('POST',`${CREATE_ROUTE}/${encodeURIComponent(S.bundle.name)}/save`,SAVE_DEADLINE_MS,{});
        S.said={kind:'ok',text:text(outcome.message)};log('info','saved',{name:S.bundle.name});
      }catch(error){
        const code=fail(error,'Enregistrement impossible :');
        log('error','save_failed',{code,message:text(error&&error.message),detail:text(error&&error.detail)});
      }finally{S.busy=null;render();if(button&&button.isConnected)button.focus({preventScroll:true})}
    }

    async function saveDestination(value){
      if(S.busy)return;
      S.busy={kind:'destination',since:now(),label:'Enregistrement de la destination',limit:PREVIEW_DEADLINE_MS};render();
      try{
        const answer=await call('POST',DESTINATION_ROUTE,PREVIEW_DEADLINE_MS,{support_email:value});
        if(S.preview)S.preview=Object.freeze({...S.preview,destination:text(answer.destination)});
        S.editing=false;S.status={kind:'ok',text:`Destination : ${text(answer.destination)}.`};
        log('info','destination_changed',{default:value.trim()===''});
      }catch(error){
        S.status={kind:'failed',text:`Destination non modifiée : ${text(error&&error.message)} (${text(error&&error.code)||'network'})`};
        log('error','destination_failed',{code:text(error&&error.code),message:text(error&&error.message)});
      }finally{S.busy=null;render()}
    }

    /* ---------------- rendu */

    function el(tag,cls,content){const n=doc.createElement(tag);if(cls)n.className=cls;if(content!==undefined)n.textContent=content;return n}
    function mark(kind){
      const ns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg',svg=doc.createElementNS(ns,'svg');
      svg.setAttribute('viewBox','0 0 24 24');svg.setAttribute('fill','none');svg.setAttribute('stroke','currentColor');
      svg.setAttribute('stroke-width','2');svg.setAttribute('stroke-linecap','round');svg.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');svg.setAttribute('focusable','false');
      const p=doc.createElementNS(ns,'path');p.setAttribute('d',kind==='in'?'M5 12.5l4.2 4.2L19 7':'M7 7l10 10M17 7L7 17');svg.appendChild(p);
      return svg;
    }
    function ensureStyle(){
      if(!doc||!doc.head||doc.getElementById('jvSupportStyle'))return;
      const style=el('style');style.id='jvSupportStyle';style.textContent=CSS;doc.head.appendChild(style);
    }
    function install(){
      if(host)return;
      ensureStyle();
      host=el('div');host.id=HOST_ID;host.hidden=true;host.setAttribute('role','dialog');host.setAttribute('aria-modal','true');
      host.setAttribute('aria-labelledby','jvSupportTitle');host.setAttribute('aria-describedby','jvSupportLede');
      const card=el('section','sp-card');
      const header=el('header');const titles=el('div');
      const title=el('h2','','Signaler un problème');title.id='jvSupportTitle';
      const lede=el('p','sp-lede','JARVIS prépare un paquet de diagnostic pour l’équipe de support : un rapport, les journaux et le contexte de votre projet, sans aucune clé ni mot de passe.');
      lede.id='jvSupportLede';titles.append(title,lede);
      const closeBtn=el('button','sp-close','Fermer');closeBtn.type='button';closeBtn.addEventListener('click',()=>close('close'));
      header.append(titles,closeBtn);
      const body=el('div','sp-body');
      const field=el('label','sp-field');field.append(el('span','','Que s’est-il passé ?'));
      const area=el('textarea');area.id='jvSupportDescription';area.maxLength=DESCRIPTION_MAX;area.rows=3;
      area.placeholder='Ce que vous faisiez, ce que vous attendiez, ce qui s’est passé.';
      area.addEventListener('input',()=>{S.description=area.value;if(S.bundle){S.bundle=null;S.saveOffered=false;S.said=null;S.sent=false;render()}});
      field.append(area,el('small','','Facultatif. Évitez d’y écrire un mot de passe.'));
      const content=el('section','sp-content');content.setAttribute('aria-label','Contenu du paquet');
      const dest=el('div','sp-dest');
      const consent=el('label','sp-consent');const box=el('input');box.type='checkbox';box.id='jvSupportConsent';
      box.addEventListener('change',()=>{S.consent=box.checked;if(S.consent&&S.status&&S.status.kind==='failed')S.status=null;render()});
      consent.append(box,el('span','','J’ai compris que ce paquet contient, masqués, mes conversations récentes avec JARVIS, la mémoire du Board actif et les journaux, et j’accepte de le transmettre au support.'));
      const result=el('div','sp-result');result.hidden=true;result.setAttribute('aria-live','polite');
      body.append(field,content);
      /* Hors du défilement : la destination, le consentement et l'issue restent visibles au-dessus des boutons. */
      const commit=el('div','sp-commit');commit.append(dest,consent,result);
      const footer=el('footer');const status=el('p','sp-status');status.setAttribute('role','status');status.setAttribute('aria-live','polite');
      const foot=el('div','sp-foot');
      const save=el('button','sp-save','Enregistrer…');save.type='button';save.addEventListener('click',()=>act('save'));
      const send=el('button','sp-send','Envoyer');send.type='button';send.addEventListener('click',()=>act('send'));
      foot.append(save,send);footer.append(status,foot);
      card.append(header,body,commit,footer);host.append(card);
      host.addEventListener('keydown',event=>{
        if(event.key==='Escape'){event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();if(S.editing){S.editing=false;render();return}close('escape');return}
        if(event.key==='Tab'){
          const focusable=[...host.querySelectorAll('button,textarea,input,a[href],summary')].filter(n=>!n.hidden&&n.offsetParent!==null);
          if(!focusable.length)return;
          const first=focusable[0],last=focusable[focusable.length-1];
          if(event.shiftKey&&doc.activeElement===first){event.preventDefault();last.focus()}
          else if(!event.shiftKey&&doc.activeElement===last){event.preventDefault();first.focus()}
        }
      });
      doc.body.appendChild(host);
      ui={area,content,dest,consent,box,result,status,save,send,closeBtn};
    }

    function renderContent(){
      const c=ui.content;c.textContent='';
      const p=S.preview;
      if(!p){
        const line=el('p','sp-said',S.previewError?`Aperçu indisponible : ${S.previewError.message} (${S.previewError.code}). Le paquet peut quand même être créé.`:'Lecture du contenu du paquet…');
        if(S.previewError){line.dataset.kind='failed';line.setAttribute('role','alert');const retry=el('button','sp-act','Réessayer');retry.type='button';retry.addEventListener('click',loadPreview);c.append(line,retry)}
        else c.append(line);
        return;
      }
      c.append(el('h3','','Contenu du paquet'));
      const board=p.board?`Board actif : ${p.board.title||p.board.id}`:'Aucun Board actif connu';
      c.append(el('p','sp-meta',`${board} · environ ${formatBytes(p.approxBytes)} avant compression.`));
      const inList=el('ul','sp-in');
      for(const item of p.included){
        const li=el('li');li.dataset.category=item.id;li.append(mark('in'),el('span','',item.label));
        li.append(el('span','sp-chip',item.bytes?`masqué · ${formatBytes(item.bytes)}`:'masqué'));inList.append(li);
      }
      const outList=el('ul','sp-out');
      for(const item of p.excluded){const li=el('li');li.dataset.category=item.id;li.append(mark('out'),el('span','',item.label));outList.append(li)}
      c.append(inList,el('h3','sp-gap','Jamais inclus'),outList);
    }

    function renderDestination(){
      const box=ui.dest;box.textContent='';
      const p=S.preview;
      if(!p){box.hidden=true;return}
      box.hidden=false;
      if(S.editing){
        const input=el('input');input.type='email';input.id='jvSupportDestination';input.value=p.destination;input.setAttribute('aria-label','Adresse du support');
        const ok=el('button','sp-act','Enregistrer');ok.type='button';ok.addEventListener('click',()=>saveDestination(input.value));
        const reset=el('button','sp-act','Adresse par défaut');reset.type='button';reset.addEventListener('click',()=>saveDestination(''));
        input.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'){e.preventDefault();saveDestination(input.value)}});
        box.append(input,ok,reset);
        later(()=>{if(input.isConnected&&doc.activeElement!==input)input.focus()},0);
        return;
      }
      const line=el('p');line.append('Destinataire : ',el('b','',p.destination),` — ${p.transport.label||'moyen d’envoi inconnu'}.`);
      const edit=el('button','sp-act','Modifier');edit.type='button';edit.dataset.role='edit-destination';edit.addEventListener('click',()=>{S.editing=true;render()});
      box.append(line,edit);
    }

    function renderResult(){
      const r=ui.result;r.textContent='';
      const b=S.bundle;
      if(!b&&!S.said){r.hidden=true;return}
      r.hidden=false;
      if(b){
        const report=b.reportKind==='ai'?'rapport IA écrit':`rapport factuel (IA : ${AI_STATUS[b.aiStatus]||'indisponible'})`;
        r.append(el('p','',`Paquet ${b.name} · ${formatBytes(b.bytes)} · ${report}${b.omitted?` · ${b.omitted} élément(s) omis, voir manifest.json`:''}.`));
      }
      if(S.said){
        const p=el('p','sp-said',S.said.text);p.dataset.kind=S.said.kind;p.setAttribute('role',S.said.kind==='failed'?'alert':'status');r.append(p);
        if(S.said.detail){const det=el('details');det.append(el('summary','','Détails'),el('code','',S.said.detail));r.append(det)}
      }
      if(b&&S.saveOffered){
        const row=el('div','sp-row');
        const docs=el('button','sp-act','Enregistrer dans Documents\\Jarvis');docs.type='button';docs.dataset.role='save-documents';
        docs.addEventListener('click',()=>saveToDocuments(docs));
        const dl=el('a','sp-act','Télécharger…');dl.href=`${CREATE_ROUTE}/${encodeURIComponent(b.name)}/download`;dl.setAttribute('download',b.name);
        dl.dataset.role='download';dl.addEventListener('click',()=>log('info','download',{name:b.name}));
        row.append(docs,dl);
        if(S.said&&S.said.kind==='failed'&&b){const retry=el('button','sp-act','Réessayer l’envoi');retry.type='button';retry.dataset.role='retry-send';retry.addEventListener('click',()=>act('send'));row.append(retry)}
        r.append(row);
      }
    }

    /* « Nouvelle présentation » (Slice 08) : un titre, puis la création par Core (son moteur par défaut, aucun nommé). Une seule à la fois,
       bornée (`CREATE_TIMEOUT_MS`) ; l'attente se voit (note avec secondes), un échec dit sa cause, la liste est relue dans tous les cas. */
    async function createPresentation(via){
      if(S.creating){say('info','Une création est déjà en cours.');return null}
      if(!home()){log('create_refused',{via,reason:'not_product_edition'},'warn');return null}
      const title=await askText({title:'Nouvelle présentation',body:'Donnez-lui un titre. Jarvis pourra ensuite en écrire les scènes à partir des sources du Dossier.',
        value:'',confirmLabel:'Créer'});
      if(title===null)return null;
      S.creating={title,since:now()};
      const ticker=typeof win.setInterval==='function'?win.setInterval(()=>render(),1000):null;
      log('create_started',{via});render();
      try{
        const answer=await call('POST',CREATE_ROUTE,{title},CREATE_TIMEOUT_MS);
        const created=answer&&answer.presentation||null;
        const id=created&&typeof created.presentation_id==='string'?created.presentation_id:null;
        log('created',{via,presentation_id:id?id.slice(0,12):null,seconds:Math.round((now()-S.creating.since)/1000)});
        S.creating=null;
        await refresh();
        say('ok',`« ${cleanLine(title,40)} » créée. Demandez à Jarvis d’en écrire les scènes, puis ouvrez-la pour les relire.`);
        const card=id?itemById(id):null;if(card)card.focus({preventScroll:true});
        return created;
      }catch(error){

          :base||`Création impossible : ${cleanLine(error&&error.message,120)||code}`;
        log(unknown?'create_outcome_unknown':'create_failed',{via,code,status:error&&error.status||null,message:cleanLine(error&&error.message,160)},unknown?'warn':'error');
        S.creating=null;

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------ données */
    async function refresh(){

        failures=0;S.lost=false;
        S.rows=Array.isArray(answer&&answer.presentations)?answer.presentations:[];
        S.playing=answer&&answer.playing||null;
        S.loaded=true;
        S.reportWanted=!!(answer&&answer.ui&&(answer.ui.request||answer.ui.reported));
        applyUiRequest(answer&&answer.ui);
        S.firstPoll=false;
        render();

        failures+=1;
        if(failures===1||failures%10===0)log('poll_failed',{code:error.code,message:cleanLine(error.message,120),failures},'warn');
        if(failures>=2&&!S.lost){S.lost=true;render()}

    function applyUiRequest(uiBlock){
      const request=uiBlock&&uiBlock.request;
      if(!request)return;
      if(S.lastSeq!==null&&request.seq<=S.lastSeq)return;
      const apply=request.fresh===true;
      S.lastSeq=request.seq;
      if(!apply)return;
      log('ui_request',{seq:request.seq,action:request.action});
      if(request.action==='show_rail'){S.pref='shown';save()}
      else if(request.action==='hide_rail'){S.pref='hidden';save()}
      reportSoon(true);
    }
    function reportSoon(immediate){
      if(destroyed)return;
      if(!S.coreOk)return;
      const body=reportBody(),key=JSON.stringify(body);
      /* Seul un CHANGEMENT part (le constat de départ est la ligne de base, jamais envoyé), puis un battement toutes les 15 s tant qu'un agent a déjà demandé ou lu l'écran. */
      if(S.lastReport===''){S.lastReport=key;S.lastReportAt=now();if(!immediate)return}
      if(!immediate&&key===S.lastReport&&!(S.reportWanted&&now()-S.lastReportAt>=REPORT_EVERY_MS))return;
      if(reportTimer)cancelLater(reportTimer);
      reportTimer=later(()=>{reportTimer=null;reportNow()},immediate?0:400);
    }
    function reportBody(){

    }
    async function reportNow(){

      catch(error){log('report_failed',{code:error.code})}
    }

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------ gestes */
    const rowOf=id=>S.rows.find(r=>r.presentation_id===id)||null;
    /* A row's click, « Ouvrir les variantes », « Éditer »: Variants, windowed (the rail and the voice stay usable), on the active variant. */
    function openRow(id,via){
      const row=rowOf(id);
      if(row&&row.archived){say('failed','Archivée : restaurez-la d’abord.');return false}
      const ex=explorerApi();
      if(!ex||typeof ex.open!=='function'){say('failed','Variantes n’est pas chargé dans cette page.');return false}
      Promise.resolve(ex.open({presentation_id:id,fullscreen:false,via:'rail'})).then(result=>{
        if(result&&result.state==='refused')say('failed',result.reason||result.code||'Variantes refusé.');
        else markSeen(id,via);

      }).catch(error=>{log('variants_open_failed',{via,error:cleanLine(error&&error.message,120)},'error');say('failed',`Ouverture impossible : ${cleanLine(error&&error.message,100)}`)});
      return true;
    }
    /* « Remotion Studio… » (§ 1, Slice 11): Variants opens on the presentation, then its « Remotion Studio » door on the scene on screen (the

    async function remotionStudio(id){
      const row=rowOf(id);

    /* Ouvrir une présentation depuis le rail, c'est la revoir (D10) : le jaune s'efface par l'action `review` de Core (acteur `user`). */
    function markSeen(id,via){

    async function edit(id){

    /* « Présenter » (§ 1, § 5): a `user_presenter` run, by the page's playback client; Variants opens on it and shows it. */
    async function play(id){

    async function write(id,body,label){
      const key=id+':'+body.action;
      if(S.busy.has(key))return null;
      S.busy.add(key);
      try{
        const answer=await call('POST',act(id),body);
        log('rail_action',{action:body.action,presentation_id:id.slice(0,12),changed:answer&&answer.changed});
        if(S.notice&&S.notice.kind==='failed')S.notice=null;
        await refresh();
        return answer;
      }catch(error){
        log('rail_action_failed',{action:body.action,code:error.code,status:error.status},'error');
        say('failed',`${label||body.action} impossible : ${cleanLine(error.message,140)}${error.code?` (${error.code})`:''}`);
        return null;
      }finally{S.busy.delete(key)}
    }
    async function run(action,id){
      const row=rowOf(id);if(!row)return;
      if(action==='open')return openRow(id,'menu');
      if(action==='edit')return edit(id);
      if(action==='studio'){if(!developer()){log('studio_hidden',{});return null}return remotionStudio(id)}
      if(action==='play')return play(id);
      if(action==='hide'||action==='show'){const a=await write(id,{action},action==='hide'?'Masquer':'Afficher');if(a)say('ok',action==='hide'?'Masquée du rail (menu Masquées pour la réafficher).':'Réaffichée dans le rail.');return}
      if(action==='ack')return write(id,{action:'acknowledge'},'Acquitter');
      if(action==='review'){const a=await write(id,{action:'review'},'Marquer comme vu');if(a)say('ok','Marquée comme vue.');return}
      if(action==='restore'){const a=await write(id,{action:'restore'},'Restaurer');if(a)say('ok','Restaurée.');return}
      if(action==='rename'){
        const value=await askText({title:'Renommer la présentation',value:row.title,confirmLabel:'Renommer'});
        if(value===null||cleanLine(value,80)===row.title)return;
        const a=await write(id,{action:'rename',title:cleanLine(value,80)},'Renommer');if(a)say('ok','Renommée.');
        return;
      }
      if(action==='archive'){
        const ok=await ask({title:`Archiver « ${cleanLine(row.title,40)} » ?`,
          lines:['Elle quitte le rail et ne se lit plus. Rien n’est effacé : elle se restaure à tout moment (bouton « Afficher les archivés », en bas du rail).'],confirmLabel:'Archiver'});

    /* Confirmation dans la page : le dialogue `.cdialog` de la page (`confirmDialog`), jamais `confirm()` ; la boîte du rail ne sert que si la page n'en a pas. */
    function ask(spec){
      const g=d.confirm||(typeof confirmDialog==='function'?confirmDialog:null);
      if(!g)return askConfirm({title:spec.title,body:(spec.lines||[]).join(' '),confirmLabel:spec.confirmLabel,danger:spec.danger});
      return Promise.resolve(g({title:spec.title,lines:spec.lines||[],confirmLabel:spec.confirmLabel,danger:!!spec.danger})).then(v=>v===true);
    }
    const PURGE_ERRORS=Object.freeze({
      presentation_studio_variant_in_playback:'elle est jouée : arrêtez la lecture d’abord.',
      presentation_studio_confirmation_stale:'le plan a changé entre-temps : réessayez.',
      presentation_studio_storage_io:'le disque ou la sauvegarde a refusé : rien n’a été effacé.',
      core_unreachable:'Jarvis ne répond pas.',core_unconfigured:'ce Control Center ne connaît pas Jarvis.',
      core_timeout:'Jarvis n’a pas répondu à temps : l’issue est inconnue, la liste est relue.',timeout:'pas de réponse à temps : l’issue est inconnue, la liste est relue.',
      network:'la connexion avec le Control Center a échoué.'});
    /* Suppression DÉFINITIVE d'une présentation : confirmation, archivage s'il reste à faire (la purge de Core ne prend que des archivées),
       plan (rien d'écrit) puis purge avec son jeton : sauvegarde complète d'abord, côté Core. Un échec laisse la présentation archivée
       (restaurable) et le dit. */
    async function deleteForever(row){
      const id=row.presentation_id,label=cleanLine(row.title,40);
      if(playingId()===id){say('failed','Cette présentation est jouée : arrêtez la lecture d’abord.');return null}
      const ok=await ask({title:`Supprimer définitivement « ${label} » ?`,
        lines:['Irréversible : la présentation, ses variantes, ses rendus et ses fichiers sont effacés du disque.','Une sauvegarde complète est faite juste avant.'],
        confirmLabel:'Supprimer définitivement',danger:true});
      if(!ok)return null;
      const key=id+':purge';
      if(S.busy.has(key))return null;
      S.busy.add(key);
      const ex=explorerApi();if(variantsPid()===id&&ex&&typeof ex.close==='function')ex.close({reason:'deleted',quiet:true});
      try{
        if(!row.archived){const a=await write(id,{action:'archive'},'Supprimer');if(!a)return null}
        const planned=await call('POST',PURGE_PLAN_ROUTE,{presentation_ids:[id]},35000);
        if(!planned||typeof planned.confirmation!=='string')throw Object.assign(new Error('Core n’a pas rendu de plan de suppression.'),{code:'purge_no_plan'});
        const done=await call('POST',PURGE_ROUTE,{confirmation:planned.confirmation,confirmed:true,presentation_ids:[id]},PURGE_TIMEOUT_MS);
        const gone=!!(done&&Array.isArray(done.purged)&&done.purged.includes(id));
        log('purged',{presentation_id:id.slice(0,12),gone,complete:!!(done&&done.complete)});
        await refresh();
        if(gone)say('ok',done.complete===false?'Supprimée ; quelques fichiers restent sur le disque (voir le journal de Core).':'Supprimée définitivement.');
        else say('failed','Suppression incomplète : la présentation reste archivée (restaurable).');
        return done;
      }catch(error){
        const code=error&&error.code||'network';
        log('purge_failed',{presentation_id:id.slice(0,12),code,status:error&&error.status||null,message:cleanLine(error&&error.message,160)},'error');
        await refresh();
        say('failed',`Suppression impossible : ${PURGE_ERRORS[code]||cleanLine(error&&error.message,120)||code} La présentation reste archivée (restaurable).`);
        return null;
      }finally{S.busy.delete(key)}
    }

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------ menu contextuel et boîtes (propres au rail : elles doivent passer AU-DESSUS du Studio) */
    function openMenuFor(row,origin,x,y){
      const items=menuModel(row,{playing:runActive(),playingThis:playingId()===row.presentation_id,developer:developer()});
      openMenu(row.title,items,origin,x,y,act=>run(act,row.presentation_id),row);
    }
    /* Le menu du rail (présentations et, étape B, éléments du Board) : en-tête, entrées, une note dit pourquoi une entrée est indisponible. */
    function openMenu(title,items,origin,x,y,onPick,row){
      closeMenu(false);
      const rect=origin.getBoundingClientRect();
      S.menuRow={row:row||null,origin,id:origin&&origin.dataset?origin.dataset.id:null};
      clear(ui.menu);
      const head=el('div','jvr-mhead',cleanLine(title,40));ui.menu.appendChild(head);
      for(const it of items){
        if(it==='-'){ui.menu.appendChild(el('div','jvr-sep'));continue}
        const b=el('button','',it.label);b.type='button';b.setAttribute('role','menuitem');b.dataset.act=it.act;
        if(it.danger)b.setAttribute('data-danger','');
        if(it.note){b.setAttribute('aria-disabled','true');b.title=it.note}
        b.addEventListener('click',()=>{
          if(it.note){say('info',it.note);return}
          if(!S.menuRow)return;
          closeMenu(true);onPick(it.act);
        });
        ui.menu.appendChild(b);
      }
      ui.menu.hidden=false;
      const w=ui.menu.offsetWidth||200,h=ui.menu.offsetHeight||240,W=Number(win.innerWidth)||1280,H=Number(win.innerHeight)||800;
      /* Rail au bord droit : le menu s'ouvre à gauche de la carte (au pointeur pour un clic droit). */
      const px=x!=null?x:rect.left-w-6,py=y!=null?y:rect.top;
      ui.menu.style.left=Math.max(8,Math.min(px,W-w-8))+'px';ui.menu.style.top=Math.max(8,Math.min(py,H-h-8))+'px';
      const first=ui.menu.querySelector('button:not([aria-disabled=true])');if(first)first.focus({preventScroll:true});
      log('menu_opened',{items:items.length});
    }
    /* A card by its canonical id (the list is rebuilt on every Core read: a kept DOM node may be detached). */
    function itemById(id){return id&&ui.host?Array.from(ui.host.querySelectorAll('.jvr-item')).find(n=>n.dataset.id===id)||null:null}
    function closeMenu(restore){
      const was=S.menuRow;S.menuRow=null;if(ui.menu){ui.menu.hidden=true;clear(ui.menu)}
      if(restore&&was&&was.origin){const target=was.origin.isConnected?was.origin:itemById(was.id);if(target)target.focus({preventScroll:true})}
    }
    function onMenuKey(event){
      const buttons=Array.from(ui.menu.querySelectorAll('button'));const i=buttons.indexOf(doc.activeElement);
      if(event.key==='Escape'){event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();closeMenu(true)}
      else if(event.key==='ArrowDown'){event.preventDefault();buttons[(i+1)%buttons.length].focus()}
      else if(event.key==='ArrowUp'){event.preventDefault();buttons[(i-1+buttons.length)%buttons.length].focus()}
      else if(event.key==='Home'){event.preventDefault();buttons[0].focus()}
      else if(event.key==='End'){event.preventDefault();buttons[buttons.length-1].focus()}
      else if(event.key==='Tab'){closeMenu(false)}
    }
    function onKey(event){
      const item=event.target&&event.target.closest&&event.target.closest('.jvr-item');
      if(!item)return;
      const all=Array.from(ui.host.querySelectorAll('.jvr-item')),i=all.indexOf(item),row=rowOf(item.dataset.id);
      if(event.key==='ArrowDown'&&i<all.length-1){event.preventDefault();all[i+1].focus()}
      else if(event.key==='ArrowUp'&&i>0){event.preventDefault();all[i-1].focus()}
      else if(event.key==='ContextMenu'||(event.key==='F10'&&event.shiftKey)){event.preventDefault();if(row)openMenuFor(row,item);else if(item.dataset.ws){const w=wsItemOf(item.dataset.id);if(w)openWsMenu(w,item)}}
      else if(event.key==='F2'&&row&&!row.archived){event.preventDefault();run('rename',row.presentation_id)}

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------- journal et retour visible (RULE ZERO) */
    function log(key,data,level){

    function tell(title,sub,kind){

    function announce(text){if(ui.live)ui.live.textContent=text}

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------- DOM */
    function el(tag,cls,text){

    function attrs(node,map){for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(map))node.setAttribute(k,String(v));return node}

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------- réseau */
    async function call(url,options){
      const o=options||{};
      if(!fetchImpl)throw new InspectorError('fetch indisponible dans cette page','unreachable',0);
      const controller=typeof AbortController==='function'?new AbortController():null;
      const timeoutMs=o.timeoutMs||REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS;
      let expired=false;
      const deadline=later(()=>{expired=true;if(controller)controller.abort()},timeoutMs);
      try{
        const response=await fetchImpl(url,{method:o.method||'GET',cache:'no-store',
          headers:o.body!==undefined?{'Content-Type':'application/json'}:undefined,
          body:o.body!==undefined?JSON.stringify(o.body):undefined,signal:controller?controller.signal:undefined});
        const text=await response.text();
        let json=null;
        try{json=text?JSON.parse(text):null}catch(_error){json=null /* a non-JSON answer is reported by its status below */}
        return {status:response.status,ok:response.ok,body:json};
      }catch(error){
        if(expired)throw new InspectorError(`Core n'a pas répondu en ${Math.round(timeoutMs/1000)} s`,'timeout',0);
        if(error&&error.name==='AbortError')throw new InspectorError('requête annulée','cancelled',0);
        throw new InspectorError(describe(error),'unreachable',0);
      }finally{cancelLater(deadline)}
    }
    function envelopeOf(response){
      const error=response.body&&response.body.error;
      return {code:error&&error.code?String(error.code):`http_${response.status}`,
        message:error&&error.message?String(error.message):`HTTP ${response.status}`,http:response.status};
    }
    async function read(url,what){
      const response=await call(url,{timeoutMs:READ_TIMEOUT_MS});
      if(!response.ok||!response.body||response.body.error){
        const e=envelopeOf(response);
        throw new InspectorError(`${what} : ${e.message}`,e.code,e.http);
      }
      return response.body;
    }
    const base=()=>`${ROUTE}/${encodeURIComponent(S.presentationId)}`;
    const variantBase=()=>`${base()}/variants/${encodeURIComponent(S.variant.variant_id)}`;

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------- attente visible */
    function setLoading(what){
      S.loading=what?{what,since:now()}:null;
      renderStatus();
    }
    /* Une seule horloge de 500 ms tant qu'une attente (chargement, rechargement) est à l'écran. */
    function syncClock(){
      const needed=!!(S.loading||S.reloading);
      if(needed&&loadingTimer===null)loadingTimer=every(()=>renderStatus(),500);
      else if(!needed&&loadingTimer!==null){stopEvery(loadingTimer);loadingTimer=null}
    }
    function setFatal(error,retry){
      S.fatal=error?{message:describe(error),code:error.code||'error',retry}:null;
      renderStatus();
    }
    function setStatus(kind,title,text,actions){
      S.status=kind?{kind,title,text,actions:actions||[],at:now()}:null;
      renderStatus();
      return S.status;
    }

    function renderStatus(){
      if(!ui.status)return;
      syncClock();
      clear(ui.statusActions);
      const spinning=!!S.loading||!!S.reloading;
      let shown=null;
      if(S.fatal)shown={kind:'bad',title:'Chargement impossible',text:`${S.fatal.message} (${S.fatal.code})`,
        actions:S.fatal.retry?[{label:'Réessayer',run:S.fatal.retry}]:[]};
      else if(S.reloading){
        const r=S.reloading;
        const left=Math.max(0,Math.ceil((r.nextAt-now())/1000));
        shown={kind:'warn',title:'Rechargement en cours',clock:`tentative ${r.attempt}/${r.max} · prochaine dans ${left} s`,
          text:'Votre modification est en attente et repartira toute seule.',
          actions:[{label:'Arrêter d\'attendre',run:()=>giveUpReload()}]};
      }else if(S.loading){
        const sec=Math.floor((now()-S.loading.since)/1000);
        shown={kind:'info',title:S.loading.what,clock:`${sec} s / ${READ_TIMEOUT_MS/1000} s`,text:''};
      }else if(S.status)shown=S.status;
      ui.status.hidden=!shown;
      if(!shown)return;
      ui.status.setAttribute('data-kind',shown.kind);
      ui.spin.hidden=!spinning;
      ui.status.setAttribute('role',shown.kind==='bad'||shown.kind==='warn'?'alert':'status');
      clear(ui.statusText);
      ui.statusText.appendChild(el('strong',null,shown.title));
      if(shown.text)ui.statusText.appendChild(doc.createTextNode(shown.text));
      if(shown.clock)ui.statusText.appendChild(el('span','jvi-clock',shown.clock));
      for(const action of shown.actions||[])ui.statusActions.appendChild(button(action.label,'jvi-btn',action.run));
      if(!shown.actions||!shown.actions.length){
        if(shown.kind==='ok'||shown.kind==='info')return;
        ui.statusActions.appendChild(button('Fermer','jvi-btn',()=>setStatus(null)));
      }
    }

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------- chargement */
    async function loadPresentations(){
      const generation=++S.generation;
      setLoading('Chargement des présentations…');setFatal(null);
      try{
        const list=await read(ROUTE,'Liste des présentations');
        if(generation!==S.generation)return;
        S.presentations=Array.isArray(list.presentations)?list.presentations:[];
        const problems=Array.isArray(list.problems)?list.problems.length:0;
        log('presentations_loaded',{count:S.presentations.length,problems});
        if(!S.presentations.some((p)=>p.presentation_id===S.presentationId))S.presentationId=S.presentations.length?S.presentations[0].presentation_id:null;
        renderPick();
        if(S.presentationId)await selectPresentation(S.presentationId,{keepScene:true});
        else{setLoading(null);S.variant=null;S.scene=null;renderAll()}
      }catch(error){
        stats.failures++;
        setFatal(error,()=>{loadPresentations()});
        log('presentations_failed',{code:error.code,error:describe(error)},'error');
        tell('Inspecteur : présentations illisibles',describe(error),'bad');
      }finally{setLoading(null)}
    }
    async function selectPresentation(id,options){
      const keep=options&&options.keepScene;
      S.presentationId=id;
      abandonDrafts('presentation');
      const body=await read(`${ROUTE}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`,'Présentation');
      const active=body.presentation&&body.presentation.active_variant_id;
      S.activeVariantId=active||null;S.presentationTitle=body.presentation&&body.presentation.title||'';
      S.variantNumbers=new Map(((body.presentation&&body.presentation.variants)||[]).filter((v)=>v&&typeof v.variant_id==='string').map((v)=>[v.variant_id,v.variant_number]));
      /* Slice 09: Variants asks for the variant ON SCREEN (any live branch, not only the active one) and its scene. */
      const want=options&&options.variantId?{variantId:options.variantId,sceneId:options.sceneId||null}:S.want&&S.want.presentationId===id?S.want:null;
      S.want=null;
      const target=want&&want.variantId||active;
      let variant=(body.variants||[]).find((v)=>v.variant_id===target)||null;
      if(!variant&&target)variant=await read(`${ROUTE}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/variants/${encodeURIComponent(target)}`,'Variante');
      S.variant=variant;syncExplore();
      S.history=null;S.art={state:'idle',doc:null,revision:null,message:''};
      const scenes=variant&&Array.isArray(variant.scenes)?variant.scenes:[];
      if(want&&want.sceneId&&scenes.some((s)=>s.scene_id===want.sceneId))S.sceneId=want.sceneId;
      else if(!keep||!scenes.some((s)=>s.scene_id===S.sceneId))S.sceneId=scenes.length?scenes[0].scene_id:null;
      renderPick();
      log('variant_loaded',{presentation_id:id,variant_id:variant&&variant.variant_id,scenes:scenes.length,revision:variant&&variant.revision});
      await Promise.all([loadScene(),loadHistory(),loadArtDirection()]);
      pollReloads();
    }
    async function loadScene(options){
      const o=options||{};
      if(!S.variant||!S.sceneId){S.scene=null;storedScene=null;renderAll();return null}
      const generation=++S.generation;
      if(!o.quiet)setLoading('Chargement des réglages…');
      try{
        const [variant,scene]=await Promise.all([
          read(variantBase(),'Variante'),
          read(`${variantBase()}/scenes/${encodeURIComponent(S.sceneId)}/controls`,'Réglages de la scène')]);
        if(generation!==S.generation)return null;
        const before=S.scene&&S.scene.scene_id===scene.scene_id?S.scene.controls:null;
        S.variant=variant;
        storedScene=(variant.scenes||[]).find((s)=>s.scene_id===S.sceneId)||null;
        S.scene=scene;
        setFatal(null);
        renderAll();
        if(!o.quiet)log('scene_loaded',{scene_id:scene.scene_id,controls:(scene.controls||[]).length,revision:scene.variant_revision,problems:(scene.problems||[]).length});
        return before?{before,after:scene.controls}:null;
      }catch(error){
        stats.failures++;
        if(error.code==='presentation_studio_unknown_scene'&&S.variant){
          log('scene_gone',{scene_id:S.sceneId},'warn');
          const scenes=S.variant.scenes||[];
          S.sceneId=scenes.length?scenes[0].scene_id:null;
          setStatus('warn','La scène n\'existe plus','Une autre modification l\'a retirée : la première scène est affichée.');
          return loadScene({quiet:true});
        }
        setFatal(error,()=>{loadScene()});
        log('scene_failed',{scene_id:S.sceneId,code:error.code,error:describe(error)},'error');
        tell('Inspecteur : réglages illisibles',describe(error),'bad');
        return null;
      }finally{if(!o.quiet)setLoading(null)}
    }
    async function loadHistory(){
      if(!S.variant)return;
      try{
        S.history=await read(`${variantBase()}/history`,'Historique');
        renderHistory();
      }catch(error){
        S.history=null;renderHistory();
        log('history_failed',{code:error.code,error:describe(error)},'warn');
      }
    }
    async function loadArtDirection(){
      if(!S.variant)return;
      const previous=S.art.revision;
      try{
        const response=await call(`${variantBase()}/art-direction`,{timeoutMs:READ_TIMEOUT_MS});
        if(response.status===404&&response.body&&response.body.error&&response.body.error.code==='presentation_studio_unknown_art_direction'){
          S.art={state:'absent',doc:null,revision:null,message:''};
        }else if(!response.ok||!response.body||!response.body.art_direction){
          const e=envelopeOf(response);
          throw new InspectorError(e.message,e.code,e.http);
        }else{
          const doc_=response.body.art_direction;
          S.art={state:'ok',doc:doc_,revision:doc_.revision,message:''};
          if(previous!==null&&previous!==doc_.revision){
            log('art_direction_changed',{from:previous,to:doc_.revision});
            announce('La direction artistique a été mise à jour.');
          }
        }
      }catch(error){
        S.art={state:'error',doc:null,revision:null,message:describe(error)};
        log('art_direction_failed',{code:error.code,error:describe(error)},'warn');
      }
      renderArt();
    }
    async function pollReloads(){
      if(!S.open||!S.available||!S.presentationId||(doc&&doc.hidden))return;
      stats.polls++;
      try{
        const body=await read(`${base()}/reloads`,'Rechargements');
        retryUnsaved();       /* Core answers again: a value kept while it was unreachable is saved now (Slice 09 QA) */
        S.reload.pending=Array.isArray(body.pending)?body.pending:[];
        S.reload.rows=Array.isArray(body.reloads)?body.reloads:[];
        const mine=S.sceneId;
        const rows=S.reload.rows.filter((r)=>r.scene_id===mine&&(!S.variant||r.variant_id===S.variant.variant_id));
        const last=rows.length?rows[rows.length-1]:null;
        const pending=S.reload.pending.find((p)=>p.scene_id===mine);
        const next=pending?{kind:'warn',title:'Source récente non confirmée',
          text:'Un nouveau modèle est en place mais la page ne l\'a pas encore vu monter : le repli enregistré reste disponible.'}:
          last&&last.status==='degraded'?{kind:'bad',title:'Source dégradée',
            text:'Le nouveau modèle n\'a pas monté et le retour arrière a échoué. La scène garde son repli enregistré : demandez un rechargement ou redémarrez Core.'}:null;
        /* Slice 06 QA-2 : un rechargement qui garde des valeurs que la nouvelle source ne peut plus accepter les NOMME (`reset.unfit`). */
        const unfit=last&&last.reset&&Array.isArray(last.reset.unfit)?last.reset.unfit:[];
        const banner=next||(unfit.length?{kind:'warn',title:'Valeurs à corriger après le rechargement',
          text:`La nouvelle source ne les accepte plus, elles sont gardées telles quelles : ${unfit.slice(0,6).join(', ')}${unfit.length>6?'…':''}.`}:null);
        const key=banner?banner.title:null;
        if(key!==S.reload.degraded){S.reload.degraded=key;if(banner)log('reload_state',{scene_id:mine,state:banner.title},banner.kind==='bad'?'error':'warn')}
        renderReloadBanner(banner);
        S.reload.versions=body.versions&&typeof body.versions==='object'?body.versions[mine]||null:null;
        S.reload.last=last;
        renderSourceLine();
        /* Un rechargement (voix ou autre) a changé la révision de la variante : on relit tout de suite, la prochaine modification part de la bonne base. */
        const rowKey=last?`${last.status}|${last.source_revision}|${last.late?'late':'now'}`:'';
        if(primedReload&&rowKey!==S.reload.rowKey){log('reload_seen',{scene_id:mine,status:last&&last.status});loadScene({quiet:true})}
        S.reload.rowKey=rowKey;
        primedReload=true;
        if(stats.polls%2===0)loadArtDirection();
      }catch(error){
        log('reloads_failed',{code:error.code,error:describe(error)},'warn');
      }
    }

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------- rendu */
    function renderPick(){
      if(!ui.pick)return;
      renderContext();
      clear(ui.pick);
      /* Slice 09: docked beside Variants, the presentation is the one Variants shows (no second choice that would desync them). */
      const at=explorerScene(),docked=!!at&&at.presentation_id===S.presentationId;
      const solo=S.presentations.length<=1||docked;
      ui.pick.className='jvi-pick'+(solo?' is-solo':'');

    /* Another scene (picker, ‹ ›, Variants, « Modifier »): never before what was typed on this one is saved (`requestMove`). */
    function chooseScene(id,options){

    }
    function switchScene(id,options){
      if(id===S.sceneId)return null;

      S.sceneId=id;S.reload.degraded=null;renderReloadBanner(null);
      renderPick();
      /* Slice 09: a scene chosen HERE while Variants shows this variant brings Variants to it (one scene on screen, never two). */

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------ leaving a scene with a draft (presentation-edition-v1 Slice 09 QA, B1)
       Variants changes the scene on screen by itself (continuous play) and the editor follows it. A value typed and not yet released used to
       be dropped in silence there, and the field kept the focus over the NEXT scene's value. Now every move (scene, variant, presentation)
       first saves what is typed on the scene it was typed on and waits for the write queue; only then does the editor move. A save that
       fails (refused, Core unreachable) keeps the editor on its scene with the draft and says so, with a way out; Variants may show another
       scene meanwhile. The latest move asked wins; the focus leaves a field whose scene changed under it. */
    const move={target:null,running:false,held:false,hold:null,resumed:null};
    function hasUnsaved(){
      for(const s of sessions.values())if(s.committing||(s.dirty&&s.draft!==undefined))return true;
      return queue.pending.size>0;
    }
    async function settleDrafts(){
      const dirty=[...sessions.values()].filter((s)=>s.dirty&&s.draft!==undefined&&!s.committing&&widgets.get(s.id));
      const items=dirty.map((s)=>({id:s.id,value:s.draft,label:widgets.get(s.id).ctx.row.label}));
      const jobs=dirty.map((s)=>{const w=widgets.get(s.id);s.unsaved=null;return onCommit(w.ctx,s.draft,{immediate:true})});
      await Promise.all(jobs);
      for(let i=0;i<8&&queue.pending.size;i++)await queue.tail;   /* a stale rebase queues once more behind itself */
      const kept=items.filter((it)=>{const w=widgets.get(it.id),x=sessions.get(it.id);return (x&&x.dirty)||!w||!sameJson(w.ctx.row.current,it.value)});
      const left=[...sessions.values()].filter((x)=>x.dirty&&x.draft!==undefined);
      const saved=items.filter((it)=>!kept.includes(it));
      /* A value whose save was already in flight when the move came is not in `items`; if it is still unsaved it is named too (Slice 09
         mini-rework, QA m1: the held move said « une valeur » and logged `kept:[]`). */
      for(const x of left){
        if(kept.some((k)=>k.id===x.id))continue;
        const w=widgets.get(x.id);
        kept.push({id:x.id,value:x.draft,label:w?w.ctx.row.label:x.id});
      }
      return {ok:!kept.length,saved,kept};
    }
    function requestMove(target){
      move.target=target;
      if(!move.running)runMove().catch((error)=>{log('move_failed',{error:describe(error)},'error');setStatus('bad','Changement de scène impossible',describe(error))});
    }
    /* A held move goes on once nothing is left unsaved (checked after the write that just ended has left the queue). */
    function resumeMove(){
      if(!move.held)return;
      later(()=>{
        if(!move.held||hasUnsaved()||move.running)return;
        const hold=move.hold;
        move.held=false;move.hold=null;
        log('move_resumed',{target:!!move.target,kept:hold?hold.count:0});
        /* Slice 09 mini-rework (QA M1): the warning « L’éditeur reste… n’est pas enregistrée » is false from here on; the move that goes on
           replaces it with what was saved and where the editor is (`runMove`), or, with no move left, it is replaced right now. */
        if(move.target){move.resumed=hold;requestMove(move.target);return}
        if(hold&&S.status===hold.status){
          const said=setStatus('ok',savedTitle(hold),'');
          later(()=>{if(S.status===said)setStatus(null)},5000);
        }
      },0);
    }
    function savedTitle(h){
      return h.names?`${h.names} enregistré${h.count>1?'s':''} sur la ${h.origin}`:`Saisie enregistrée sur la ${h.origin}`;
    }
    async function runMove(){
      move.running=true;
      try{
        for(;;){
          const t=move.target;
          if(!t)return;
          let saved=null;
          if(hasUnsaved()){
            const origin=sceneLabel(S.sceneId)||'scène en cours';
            const typing=!!(ui.root&&doc.activeElement&&ui.root.contains(doc.activeElement)&&inTextField(doc.activeElement));
            setStatus('info','Enregistrement de votre saisie…',` Sur la ${origin}, avant de changer de scène.`);
            log('move_saving',{kind:t.kind,from:S.sceneId,to:t.sceneId||null});
            const r=await settleDrafts();
            if(!r.ok){
              move.held=true;
              const names=r.kept.map((k)=>`« ${clip(k.label,40)} »`).join(', ')||'une valeur';
              const said=setStatus('warn',`L’éditeur reste sur la ${origin}`,
                ` Votre saisie (${names}) n’est pas enregistrée : l’éditeur ne change pas de scène tant qu’elle n’est ni enregistrée ni abandonnée.`,
                [{label:'Abandonner ma saisie et continuer',run:()=>{const target=move.target;abandonDrafts('user');move.held=false;move.hold=null;setStatus(null);if(target)requestMove(target)}}]);
              move.hold={status:said,origin,names:r.kept.length?names:'',count:r.kept.length};
              announce(`Saisie non enregistrée : l’éditeur reste sur la ${origin}.`);
              log('move_held',{kind:t.kind,kept:r.kept.map((k)=>k.id)},'warn');
              return;
            }
            saved={origin,count:r.saved.length,typing};
            if(move.target!==t)continue;      /* a newer move arrived while saving: that one is applied (the draft is saved) */
          }else if(move.resumed){
            const h=move.resumed;             /* a held move going on: its value was saved meanwhile (`resumeMove`) */
            saved={origin:h.origin,count:h.count,names:h.names,
              typing:!!(ui.root&&doc.activeElement&&ui.root.contains(doc.activeElement)&&inTextField(doc.activeElement))};
          }
          move.resumed=null;
          move.target=null;
          await t.apply();
          if(saved){
            const where=sceneLabel(S.sceneId);
            const said=setStatus('ok',savedTitle(saved),where?` · l’éditeur montre maintenant la ${where}.`:'');
            later(()=>{if(S.status===said)setStatus(null)},5000);
            announce(`${savedTitle(saved)}.${where?` L’éditeur montre maintenant la ${where}.`:''}`);
            log('move_after_save',{kind:t.kind,saved:saved.count});
            /* The field now shows another scene's value: the caret never stays there (the next key would edit that scene). */
            if(saved.typing&&ui.title)ui.title.focus();
          }
        }
      }finally{move.running=false}
    }
    /* ------------------------------------------------------------ Variants and the editor (presentation-edition-v1 Slice 09) */
    function explorerApi(){return root.JarvisStudioExplorer||null}
    function explorerScene(){

    /* What is being edited, in words (RULE ZERO: the active scene and variant are always clear). */
    function renderContext(){

    function document_text(text){return doc.createTextNode(text)}
    /* Said to the page after every committed change (edit, undo, redo): Variants re-reads the variant from Core. */
    /* `bring` (undo / redo only): Variants brings that scene on screen. A plain save never moves Variants: a value saved while Variants had
       already moved on (its continuous play, Slice 09 QA B1) must not pull it back. */
    function sayEdited(revision,sceneId,bring){
      if(typeof win.dispatchEvent!=='function'||typeof win.CustomEvent!=='function'||!S.variant)return;
      try{win.dispatchEvent(new win.CustomEvent('jarvis:studio-variant-edited',{detail:{presentation_id:S.presentationId,variant_id:S.variant.variant_id,
        revision:Number.isInteger(revision)?revision:null,scene_id:sceneId||S.sceneId||null,bring:bring===true}}))}

    /* Variants changed the scene (or the variant) on screen: the editor follows, when it edits the same presentation. */
    function onExplorerScene(event){
      const d=event&&event.detail||{};
      if(!S.open||!d.presentation_id||d.presentation_id!==S.presentationId)return;
      if(S.variant&&d.variant_id===S.variant.variant_id){

        return;
      }

        .catch((error)=>{setFatal(error,()=>{loadPresentations()});log('follow_failed',{code:error.code,error:describe(error)},'error')})});

    /* « Modifier » in Variants: open beside it on that variant and that scene. */
    async function edit(request){
      const r=request||{};
      if(typeof r.presentation_id!=='string'||typeof r.variant_id!=='string')return {state:'refused',reason:'présentation ou variante manquante'};
      log('edit_requested',{via:r.via||'api',variant_id:r.variant_id,scene_id:r.scene_id||null});
      /* Closing the editor gives the focus back to what opened it (« Modifier » in Variants), when it is still there (Slice 09 QA m1). */
      S.opener=r.opener&&typeof r.opener.focus==='function'?r.opener:null;
      if(S.open){
        if(S.presentationId===r.presentation_id&&S.variant&&S.variant.variant_id===r.variant_id){
          if(r.scene_id&&r.scene_id!==S.sceneId)chooseScene(r.scene_id,{fromExplorer:true});
        }else if(hasUnsaved()){
          requestMove({kind:'variant',sceneId:r.scene_id,apply:()=>selectPresentation(r.presentation_id,{variantId:r.variant_id,sceneId:r.scene_id})

    function renderHistory(){
      if(!ui.undo)return;

    function renderAll(){
